Guidance & outlook: For FY26, the company reported revenue from operations of INR60.61 crores as compared to INR38.85 crores in FY 25.
Profit after tax for FY26 increased to INR 7.23 crores as compared to INR 4.59 crores in FY 25.

We are pleased to share that our current order book stands at approximately INR 95 crores providing strong revenue visibility for the coming years and reinforcing the sustainability of our growth trajectory.
Growth & demand: More importantly this growth was driven by our core busines s.
Currently, the 50% of the order book is come from -- Yeah, average you can say 50% of the customers are repeated clients.
You can say, out of that total INR 35 crore, we are going to get around INR 10 crore membership from our current order booking.
Margins & costs: Another landmark achievement is the execution of 5 MLD and 1.7 MLD sewage treatment plant at Sirohi Rajasthan for Larsen & Toubro with a project value of approximately INR 20 crores.
Our EBITDA margin remained healthy during the year supported by operational efficiency, improvements, project execution management, cost optimization initiatives and disciplined financial controls.
A significant recent achiev ement has been the award of INR 25.5 crore project for the construction of 25 MLD sewage treatment plant at Sasaram, Bihar.
Capex & expansion: Importantly, the company maintained healthy operational profitability despite continuous investment in capacity building, execution strengthening and infrastructure development.
We are targeting the acquisition of projects with a value of more than INR 50 crore from government authorities.
In terms of revenue after commission, in the Phase 1, we are going to get around INR 80 lakh per month revenue, recurring revenue after commissions.
Balance sheet & cash: This performance demonstrates the scalability of our business model, improving operat ing leverages, disciplined project execution and focus on profitable growth.
The company remains focused on improving working capital efficiency, optimizing project cash flows and maintaining a healthy financial structure while supporting future growth requirements.
Therefore, thi s INR 38 crore receivable is currently reflecting in our books.
Risks & challenges: Today, industries are increasingly focused on water security, water reuse, resource efficiency, sustainability commitments and long-term environmental risk management.
Actually, I don't feel there is any increase in competition.
In day-to-day life and everywhere, you can see, we are facing the challenges like water scarcity.
